title: The Better Food And Cooking Mod
description: This mod adds more food to Minecraft.
body:
This Mod adds:

New types of food like zombie bacon (ew)! And lots of new food ingriedients like sugar, flour, salt, pepper and blocks of those for more variatoin of food!

It changes the food system so that you have a cool experiecne. I hope you'll enjoy my mod and have fun eating and cooking!
